executiveSummary: Harborline grew revenue 10% in Q3 FY26 to $14.4M while burn fell to $1.8M, putting cash-flow break-even at Q2 FY27, two quarters early. Growth is coming from retention, not new logos; we ask the board to move $600K to sales to fix that.

slides.slideTitle: Q3 FY26: growth with a shrinking burn
slides.subtitle: Board update · Harborline Logistics · November 2026
slides.speakerNotes:
- Thanks for making time. This is our Q3 update.
- One message: we grew faster while spending less, and we can be cash-flow positive by Q2 FY27.
slides.intent: Set the frame for the quarter

keyBullets: Results: revenue, margin, retention
Cash: burn and runway
Risks: two we are watching
Decisions: what we need from the board
slides.speakerNotes: - Four parts, thirty minutes, decisions at the end.

slides.subtitle: Quarterly revenue, $M
keyBullets: Our fifth straight quarter of double-digit growth
slides.speakerNotes:
- $14.4M, up 10% on Q2 and 47% on a year ago.
- Growth came from mid-market accounts, not price.

slides.slideTitle: Gross margin is up seven points in a year
slides.subtitle: Gross margin, %
keyBullets: Routing automation took 4 points out of cost of service
slides.speakerNotes:
- 61% to 68%.
- Most of it is the routing engine we shipped in Q1.

keyBullets: $14.4M: revenue, up 47% year over year
68%: gross margin, up 7 points
114%: net revenue retention
289: customers, up 23 this quarter
slides.speakerNotes: - The four numbers we report every quarter.
slides.intent: Give the board the numbers to remember

slides.slideTitle: Burn fell to $1.8M, the lowest in two years
slides.subtitle: Net burn, $M per quarter
keyBullets: Burn is down 42% since Q3 FY25

slides.slideTitle: We can be cash-flow positive by Q2 FY27
keyBullets: Q2 FY27
the quarter we reach cash-flow break-even at current trends
slides.speakerNotes:
- At the current trend, burn crosses zero in Q2 FY27.
- That is two quarters earlier than the plan you approved in March.
slides.intent: Make the board feel the turn

slides.slideTitle: Retention, not new logos, drove the growth
keyBullets: Existing customers: 114% net retention, up from 104%
New customers: 23 added, flat with last quarter
slides.speakerNotes:
- The growth is coming from customers expanding.
- New logo acquisition is flat. That's the risk on the next slide.
slides.intent: Show what is working and what is not

slides.slideTitle: Two risks could push break-even back a quarter
keyBullets: medium / high: new-logo growth stays flat
low / high: our largest customer, 9% of revenue, renews late
high / low: fuel costs rise 15%
slides.speakerNotes:
- New logos is the one we watch most.
- The largest renewal is in March; early signs are good.
slides.intent: Make the board trust the plan by naming what could break it

slides.slideTitle: We will fix new-logo growth with two moves
keyBullets: Partner channel: three freight brokers signed, live in January
Self-serve tier: launches in Q4 for fleets under 20 trucks
slides.speakerNotes: - Two bets, both already funded in the current budget.
slides.intent: Show the plan has a response

slides.slideTitle: What we need from the board
keyBullets: The issue: new-logo growth is flat for two quarters
The options: hire four sellers now, or wait for the partner channel
We recommend: hire two now, two after January's partner results
We need: approval for $600K of the existing budget to move to sales
supportingFacts: Approve the $600K move today, so the first hires start in December.
slides.speakerNotes: - This is the one decision on the agenda.
slides.purpose: Puts the decision to the board

keyBullets: Open two sales roles — Dana Ruiz — December 1
Partner channel goes live — Sam Okafor — January 15
Q4 board update — Lee Park — February 12
slides.intent: Leave the board with who does what

slides.subtitle: So two sellers start in December and break-even holds at Q2 FY27
slides.speakerNotes: - Thank you. Questions, then the vote.
slides.intent: Make the ask the last thing said
